messages:
maria: FYI saw a spike in per-key charges this morning, some orgs report much higher token usage than expected. looks correlated with retries + tool calls :thinking:
samir: ugh. any sample request ids?
maria: pasted a minimal trace below — two retries, third success. billing shows tokens for all three attempts + tool subcalls counted twice.
maria: ```
request_id=01F3X2.. user_key=org_ABC prompt_tokens=48 completion_tokens=120 tool_calls=[search:30] attempt=1 status=retry
request_id=01F3X2.. user_key=org_ABC prompt_tokens=48 completion_tokens=0 tool_calls=[search:30] attempt=2 status=retry
request_id=01F3X2.. user_key=org_ABC prompt_tokens=48 completion_tokens=120 tool_calls=[search:30] attempt=3 status=success
```
lee: so accounting counted prompt_tokens (48) three times and completion_tokens (120) twice? and tool tokens multiple times?
maria: exactly. quota dashboard shows ~3x of prompt and 3 tool call charges.
aditya: quick note: our current reservation hook deducts reserve on request submit, then on commit we deduct actual; but I thought we had dedupe for retries?
sophie: we do a dedupe by request_id at the consumer layer, but retries create new request_ids at the edge for idempotency. that defeats dedupe if the API client doesn't set idempotency_key.
samir: are clients not setting idempotency keys? which callers?
maria: looks like mobile SDK wasn't sending idempotency_key for streaming + toolcall flow. backend retry wrapper re-generated request_id each retry.
aditya: proposed fix: change reservation -> mark as provisional with a temporary token hold keyed by idempotency_key when present, else by (user_key, kvhash of prompt+tools) for n seconds. commit removes hold and charges final. rollback releases.
lee: sounds reasonable. edge cases: streaming partial completions (we currently charge completion tokens as they stream). if we hold prompt+estimated completion we may under/over reserve.
sophie: can we change to two-phase: reserve only prompt tokens + tool-call worst-case; charge completion tokens on commit/stream end? that would avoid double charging prompt on retries because prompt is identical.
samir: telemetry question: how do we expose this in console so customers see reserved vs billed? we should add a column in the per-route dashboard: reserved_tokens, billed_tokens, released_tokens.
maria: +1. ops-bot: can you run a query to show how many accounts hit >10% discrepancy between reserved and billed in last 24h?
ops-bot: query queued. ETA ~90s. (automated)
quota-bot: alert: 24h scan found 142 keys with >10% reserved_vs_billed delta, top bucket = mobile SDK v1.2.3
aditya: ok next steps: 1) quick patch to reservation logic to dedupe by idempotency_key if present (hotfix), 2) change default reservation policy to reserve prompt+tool worst-case only (follow-up), 3) add dashboard column + telemetry events (reserved/released/commit) (tracking ticket).
lee: assignable owners? aditya for hotfix, sophie for reservation policy change, maria for dashboard telemetry, samir for customer comms + release notes.
sophie: I'll open PR with the heuristic and tests. plan to gate behind feature flag for Dedicated and Hosted for 2 weeks.
maria: great. i'll draft a short note to Growth/SRE customers explaining why they might see short-lived "reserved" spikes and the upcoming fix.
samir: thanks all. can we follow up in ~48h with metrics after hotfix? :thumbsup:
maria: yes — will post results in this thread.
